If you are stronger in deployment, infrastructure and platform engineering, see the Platform focus posting for the same role. As a Forward Deployed Financial Engineer , you will lead the discovery and delivery of Datarails' AI transformation engagements for existing customers. After a customer completes implementation, you will work closely with their team to understand how they operate, identify where AI can create meaningful value, and determine what Datarails can build with them. You will develop a comprehensive recommendation and then take an active role in bringing that vision to life. The solutions may include AI skills, routines, applications, agents, or workflows. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, navigating ambiguity, and building practical solutions that solve real business problems. In the Applied AI focus, you are the engineer who takes on the engagements where the AI itself is the hard part: agents that reason over financial data, systems that chain steps and check their own work, and applications that put those systems in front of a finance team. You set the bar for how the team builds and evaluates AI systems. You will also serve as an important bridge between customers and our R&D and Product teams, helping translate customer needs into scalable capabilities and influencing the future of the Datarails platform. What You’ll Do Help customers answer: What do we need, and how can we build it together? Lead discovery sessions with customers to understand their processes, challenges, goals, and AI transformation opportunities. Develop comprehensive recommendations and solution plans for customer AI transformation projects. Design, build and ship customer-facing solutions, including AI agents, skills, routines, workflows and applications, on top of Datarails, Claude and the customer's connected systems. Define how the solutions you build are tested and evaluated, so the team knows they work before a customer relies on them. Take ownership of projects from initial discovery and recommendation through development and delivery. Work directly with customers throughout the engagement, translating business requirements into practical technical solutions. Engage customers in change management, helping usher their teams into a more AI-native way of working. Build prototypes and products that address immediate customer needs while identifying opportunities for broader reuse. Partner closely with Datarails Customer Success, Product and R&D teams to troubleshoot challenges, communicate customer requirements, and influence product development. Identify recurring customer needs that could evolve into scalable platform capabilities. Clearly explain technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Document solutions, learnings, and repeatable approaches that can improve future customer engagements. What We’re Looking For Two things come first, whatever the focus: You are good in front of the customer. You can run discovery with a finance team, explain a tradeoff to a controller, and hold the room when the plan changes. Half of this job is that. You ship. You own a problem from the first conversation through to a working solution the customer actually uses. Then three technical areas, weighted in this order for the Applied AI focus: Applied AI. Marry the Business Value with the AI Use Case. You understand and continue growing in the business domain so you can bridge the AI solution with what matters to the customer Deployment. You can get what you build running somewhere other than your laptop: APIs and integrations, a cloud environment, authentication. Also: Production experience in Python or TypeScript, with SQL and REST APIs. Hands-on experience with modern LLM tooling: agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol, tool use, evals. jobs.description: Senior Software Engineer, AI Builder (Python) - Datarails Careers Skip to content Senior Software Engineer, AI Builder (Python) Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel Apply Now About Datarails Datarails is a cloud-based financial planning and analysis (FP&A) platform designed for SMBs, transforming manual monthly and quarterly reporting into automated, scalable processes. Our solution connects to organizational systems such as ERP, CRM, HRIS, and complex Excel files, consolidating data into a single cloud-based platform. Datarails automates critical financial processes including FX conversions, eliminations, hierarchies, financial adjustments, and more, while allowing end-users to continue working in Excel as they always have. Serving primarily the US market, Datarails is experiencing strong and sustained growth. This is an exciting opportunity to help build a cutting-edge SaaS product at scale and shape how we build and deliver software in an AI-native way. The Role We’re looking for a senior engineer who is ready to move beyond traditional software development and take full ownership of product delivery. This is not a classic backend engineering role. You will work directly with Product to turn ideas and requirements into production-ready solutions, make the technical decisions, and use AI coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You will own the outcome, not just the code. AI-generated code is your code, and you are accountable for its quality, security, performance, and maintainability. What makes this role different End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. AI-native development: Use AI coding agents as a core part of your daily workflow across development, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation. Engineering judgment: Review, challenge, and validate AI-generated solutions, making sure what gets shipped is correct, secure, scalable, and maintainable. Product partnership: Product owns the what, you own the how. Work closely with Product to understand the problem, challenge assumptions, evaluate trade-offs, and find pragmatic technical solutions. Broad technical ownership: Strong software engineering fundamentals and solid understanding of architecture and design principles. Python and Django will be the primary technologies, but you will take responsibility for whatever is required to deliver a feature, including frontend, QA, automation, infrastructure, and integrations Outcome focused: Success is measured by the quality and impact of what you ship, not by the amount of code you write. What you’ll do Own product features end-to-end, from requirements through production and monitoring. Work with Product to translate business problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Design scalable and maintainable solutions, including architecture, APIs, data models, and integrations. Use AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and automation. Review and improve AI-generated code, ensuring high standards for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. Make independent technical decisions and communicate architectural trade-offs clearly. Contribute across backend, frontend, QA, CI/CD, and infrastructure when needed to deliver a feature. Investigate and solve complex production and performance issues. Continuously improve how we build, test, and ship software using AI-native development practices. About you Must have BSc in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 7+ years of experience building and shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features or systems end-to-end. Strong system design fundamentals and experience building scalable SaaS systems in the cloud. Ability to make sound architectural decisions independently and understand technical trade-offs. Solid understanding of REST APIs, asynchronous programming, distributed systems, microservices, and testing. Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar. Strong ability to review, challenge, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying on it blindly. Strong product mindset, with the ability to balance technical and business priorities and focus on solving the underlying problem. Strong ownership mentality and ability to drive work independently from idea to production. Excellent communication skills and high proficiency in English, with the ability to work directly with Product and engineering teams. Nice to have Experience with modern frontend technologies, particularly Angular. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Helm. Familiarity with Celery, RabbitMQ, event-driven architectures, or streaming systems. Experience with cloud infrastructure, Docker, and Kubernetes.
